hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); reason=""; if echo "$cmd" | grep -Pq '(^|[;&|]|\s)find\s+/(\s|$)'; then reason="Root-anchored find is not allowed - scope the search to a specific directory (e.g. '.', a repo path)."; elif echo "$cmd" | grep -Pq '(^|[;&|]|\s)rg\s+(\S*\s+)*/(\s|$)'; then reason="Root-anchored rg is not allowed - scope the search to a specific directory (e.g. '.', a repo path)."; elif echo "$cmd" | grep -Pq '(^|[;&|]|\s)grep\s+(\S*\s+)*-[a-zA-Z]*[rR][a-zA-Z]*(\s+\S+)*\s+/(\s|$)'; then reason="Root-anchored recursive grep is not allowed - scope the search to a specific directory (e.g. '.', a repo path)."; fi; if [ -n "$reason" ]; then jq -n --arg reason "$reason" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$reason}}'; else echo '{}'; fi
